purpose: First two steps of the continuation plan: iid static one-slope positive controls and finite-backend quantization; no nonlinear gated or coupled-chip claim.
model: R=a*(X+D) or floor(a*(X+D)); Y=k*R-D; frozen k within 120 conversion slots, simultaneous one-coefficient window update. X and independent equiprobable D have no history. Ideal backend is an offline control, not extra hardware information.
quantizer_contract: Assumed scalar 10-bit offset-binary backend, centered codes -512..511, input -512..512, step 1; match existing floating SAR expression floor(value+512)-512, not mid-bin reconstructed voltage. Near a bin boundary adding512 may round across it; retain and count discrepancies from exact floor(value). Analytic population integrals use exact floor and hold almost everywhere for continuous inputs; their floating difference is not a certified error bound. This is not the two-stage Gu readout nor its measured quantizer resolution.
step_provenance: Keep the EXP-055 scalar control and recent first-coefficient candidate's code/step scales. Factor 30 is an assumed mean-speed normalization, not a paper-disclosed chip step.
rng_contract: PCG64; independent SeedSequence children for input and dither per seed/input/method, shared latent observations across gains/quantizers. Methods have independent streams; comparisons concern distributions and budgets, not the exact same physical record.
checkpoint_counts: point30 learning=0,10000,33336,100000,1000000; full120 learning=0,300000,1000080,3000000,30000000. Same-learning comparison uses point30 at250000 and full120 at8334 (80 extra observations due to complete-window alignment). Same-conversion comparison uses equal windows.
acceleration: 1024-window chunks of affine recurrences using prefix products and sums; abort on nonpositive factors or coefficients outside [0,2], no silent clipping. Cross-check direct window-product and original gated_lms block-mean reference before long runs, and replay all transitions afterwards.
scoring: Fixed coherent tone with fresh independent dither: unit k, each declared checkpoint frozen, each checkpoint continued online, inverse gain and population zero-correlation k. Report MSE relative to X, DC error, SNDR and SFDR of continuous corrected codes; no extra output rounding. Population expected MSE separates mean offset, backend residual and coefficient variance. Test/oracle input never enters updates.

acceptance.policy: Keep every seed and failure. Statistical checks validate declared scalar moments, not chip fidelity or universal performance. More samples need not remove constant-step noise. No performance gate is used to select a method or tune step, input, seed or checkpoint. Tail tests use predicted temporal covariance, not iid sample errors. A stable tail is finite-run evidence only.

counting_boundary: Generate only selected iid static observations. 30M conversion slots/path are inferred elapsed conversion counts, not executions of the two-stage ADC platform. Full120 generates all 30M scalar observations/path; point30 generates1M. No dynamic history is omitted because none exists in this declared control. One coefficient is always active; higher PWL gates are not studied.
freeze: Copy and hash protocol before any outcomes, hash theory, experiment, original LMS/PWL/SAR/architecture and RTL; refuse overwrite; retain preflight failures and all long-run outputs.
next: After this controlled statistical audit, separately freeze static two-stage smooth nonlinear and backend-error tests, then fixed-point and dynamic controls. Do not transfer scalar success/noise rankings to eight-state Gu or invent a new algorithm now.
